priorExposure: Retrospective selection from the documented roadmap. The reviewer has read all six legacy cards and their incoming assertions, the descriptions of their external parents, and initial primary abstracts. Familiarity with retinal physiology and the previous Level-0 review precludes any blind or preregistered claim.
question: Which experimentally scoped processes, structures, inputs and functional dependencies can replace the six broad optical/retinal catalogue cards without asserting their derivation from Level 0?
inclusion: Account for every field, evidence entry and incoming assertion of the six selected legacy cards.
Admit a published observation only with an identified work, reviewed locator, organism/preparation, observable and explicit support limit.
A scoped operating mechanism may be represented without adjudicating the entire broad external-parent card. Record that specialization explicitly and leave that parent's global review pending.
Distinguish anatomical development, optical delivery, photochemistry, cellular response, spatial sampling, circuit filtering and spike generation.
Prefer primary experiments for empirical support. Reviews can resolve bibliographic identity or orient the search but do not replace a claim-specific primary test.
exclusion: No universal necessity, sufficient cause, quantitative weight or carrier threshold follows from the legacy label or a related publication title.
Do not combine different species and preparations into a purportedly validated single-organism cascade or measured transfer model.
Do not infer developmental generation from a functional perturbation, or claim that a diagram ablation is a biological intervention.
Do not silently identify rods and cones, all ganglion-cell classes, image-forming and intrinsic melanopsin pathways, or anatomical topography and functional visual mapping.
No independent prediction, exhaustive minimality, geometric advantage, successful CRT promotion or whole-graph validation is claimed without its own admissible target and test.

decisions.retain-scoped: Keep a supported relation between reviewed pilot concepts, with explicit context and observational limits; legacy numerical and necessity claims are separately withheld.
decisions.replace-scoped: Replace the broad assertion with a specified operating input or mechanism. A specialized external context does not constitute full review of its legacy ancestor.
decisions.withhold: Adopt no active replacement for this assertion; name the missing evidence, category error or scoped alternative and a revisiting condition. This is not proof of physical absence.

comparison: Record the original coarse chain, a scoped mechanism reconstruction, and explicit bypass/developmental alternatives. Use already inspected publications as retrospective discriminating observations. A held-out prediction or quantitative graph-ranking experiment remains unavailable until a target dataset and evaluation policy are frozen.
acceptance: Six node reviews, seventeen evidence-entry dispositions and twenty-two exact incoming-parent dispositions; complete reciprocal source/claim/context/replacement accounting, declared missingness and historical release replay. Internal completion is separate from independent scientific validation.
